title: Director of cloud infrastructure at a large insurer

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks for joining. What prompted you to take this call?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We're moving our claims assistant from a cloud API to running our own models on prem, mainly for data residency.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Interesting. What does the on-prem footprint look like?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Two racks of GPUs in our Hartford data center today, and finance is already asking why the bill doubled.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: When you say the bill doubled, how do you measure inference cost today?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Mostly cost per thousand claims processed. We're at about eleven dollars and the target from the CFO is six.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That's a clear target. What alternatives are you looking at?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Our current GPU vendor wants to sell us a third rack, and we've had a demo from Vantage Fabric.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Who would need to approve bringing in a new vendor?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Procurement and our security architecture board. Security reviews here usually take three to four months.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Is there a date you're working toward?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Budget for next year locks in October, so anything we want funded has to be justified by then.
